versions.changelog: V2 remediation: add Clean Scan Evidence and Install-First Success Path to ACCEPTANCE.md (Example Prompts already present)

Initial release of "event-ticket-help-sheet"—a skill to organize ticket troubleshooting and entry action plans.

- Provides a structured help sheet for users with event ticket issues, especially close to event time.
- Captures essential ticket facts, gathers a proof bundle, and outlines official contact options.
- Supplies copy-ready support messages, arrival plans, and on-site scripts for gate or staff interactions.
- Includes step-by-step guides for common ticketing problems and what not to do.
- Builds every output for urgent, legitimate, and safe resolution—no support for bypassing rules or creating fake records.
